preconditions: Private native Linux work storage, independently retained initial binding, fresh built-in command registry, explicit build fixtures and actual generated relocatable Core distributions.
steps: Plan one supported complete read-only handler without execution; publish initial work and run a resume through current runtime/context checks under a continuously held work mutex.
Check exact stored machine results and unchanged request/work/plan bindings; resume again without rerunning the handler or creating a new generation.
Move a real generated module or zipapp and the work/protected roots, then resume and reuse results from new isolated processes without retained session state.
Reject incompatible or absent runtime/work, unsupported plans, missing checkpoint bytes and incomplete handler outcomes; preserve the actual previous checkpoint on publication failure.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein bestätigter Arbeitsstand MUSS ohne erforderlichen prozesslokalen Zustand in einer neuen kompatiblen Runtime fortsetzbar sein.
oracle.scope: 6.m.W provides a Python embedding API for a closed single-unit plan executing six existing read-only bootstrap Core handlers. The running distribution must have a recorded build matching the independently trusted initial work binding. Every call rechecks current runtime support, work/protected roots and the invocation context; a live work lease spans the actual handler execution and durable publication of its complete machine result. A fresh built-in registry prevents a saved registry from replacing handlers. Recorded completion bytes bind the original request, unit, build, outcome and actual exit code and are revalidated/reused without a second handler invocation. Real generated module and zipapp distributions resume after runtime/work/protected-root renames in independent isolated processes. Other tests use explicitly injected in-process build records. Missing inputs, unsupported plans, incompatible builds, incomplete handler outcomes and publication errors cannot confirm new progress. Work remains running pending later global finalization. General work-resume CLI integration, Code 8, normative actor/request/plan/target checks, multi-unit scheduling, copying/portable restore and full work completion remain open; no complete requirement or release pass is asserted.

open_items: General work-resume CLI and Code-8/closure integration, normative actor/request/plan/target revalidation, multi-unit work and portable copy/restore remain open. The first executable read-only embedding path is partial coverage only.
